name: kodhe/auth
description: Session-based authentication component for the Kodhe framework, with a native Socialite (OAuth) bridge for unified password + social login

suggest.psr/event-dispatcher: Required by the Bridge\\PsrAuthEventDispatcher adapter that forwards AuthEvents to any PSR-14 dispatcher (e.g. kodhe/events)
suggest.kodhe/socialite: Provides the OAuth providers (Google, GitHub, Facebook, GitLab, LinkedIn, Twitter) consumed by kodhe/auth's SocialiteAuth bridge
